purpose: #86: VBIC 1.3 CE amplifier with excess phase (TD > 0) against VACASK running the VBIC 1.3 reference Verilog-A.

oracle.derivation: VACASK (unstable-2026) with vbic_1p3_4t.osdi (VBIC 1.3 reference Verilog-A, sw_et=0), ac from 1e5 to 1e10, 100 points/decade, options reltol=1e-10 vntol=1e-12 abstol=1e-15. i(q1) is the xf2 node voltage espice publishes under ngspice's excess-phase branch name; vmeas/vcc currents from flow(br).
